posts.text:
New trend I'm observing:

1. Startup raises venture capital
2. Uses venture dollars to become creator 
3. Startup fails
4. Fall back on becoming a full-time creator and makes $500k-$5M/year as creator
5. Incubates other products bootstrapped
6. Never raises VC again
posts.text_zh:
我观察到的新趋势：

1. 创业公司融到风险投资
2. 用风投的钱把自己做成创作者
3. 创业公司失败
4. 退回去做全职创作者，一年靠创作赚 $500k-$5M
5. 再用自举的方式孵化其他产品
6. 再也不向 VC 融资

posts.text:
Added this section from @X's own rules

Most people don't know that AI reply bots are explicitly not permitted to run on here

And duplicate pasting the same reply with automation is the same thing

X has an entire page dedicated to it

The reason for the "Let's connect 🤝" reply spam is simple, people run automated bots (or do it manually) so that when they get a reply with connect in it, they follow the person and that person automatically follows them too

That way they both get 1 new follower, and that brings them closer to the minimum of 500 verified followers to get accepted into X's Monetization program

Before reply spamming paid you good money: about $10 per million views, so they scripted that and auto replied and they made money. But @X killed that in January this year. Now only timeline views pay you money

Also you need 500,000 impressions in the last 3 months (~166,000 per month) to get into X's Monetization Program, so the idea is to pump replies/posts too such a high level that you force these amounts of views

Now the scheme is to grow an account to a few thousand followers, then sell it, or use it for paid product placements, crypto pump and dumps or AI apps/tools

A large part of spam comes from poor countries where just making $100/mo more from X makes a big difference, so I get it, but I think we should also actively fight it because reply spam is destroying this platform and then people will just leave and I don't like that

I made so many friends on here over the last decade and want to continue doing so, if most of my interactions on here are with spam bots, I won't be able to do that anymore!

https://t.co/jDDqmG0c8h
posts.text_zh:
我从 @X 自己的规则里加了这一段

大多数人不知道，AI 回复机器人在这里是被明确禁止运行的

而且用自动化重复粘贴同一条回复，性质是一样的

X 有整整一页专门讲这个

那些 “Let's connect 🤝” 回复垃圾信息的原因其实很简单：有人会跑自动机器人（或者手工操作），一旦收到带 connect 字样的回复，他们就去关注对方，而对方也会自动回关

这样一来双方各多 1 个新粉丝，也就更接近进入 X 的 Monetization program 所需的 500 个认证粉丝最低门槛

以前靠回复刷垃圾还能赚不少：大约每百万浏览 $10，所以他们写了脚本自动回复来赚钱。但 @X 在今年 1 月把这条路掐掉了。现在只有时间线浏览才给你钱

另外，要进入 X 的 Monetization Program，你还需要最近 3 个月有 500,000 次展示（大约每月 166,000），所以他们的想法是把回复/发帖刷到极高的量，强行凑够这些浏览量

现在这套玩法是：把一个账号养到几千粉，然后卖掉，或者拿去接付费植入、crypto pump and dumps，或推广 AI 应用/工具

很大一部分垃圾信息来自贫穷国家，在那些地方，每月哪怕多赚 $100 也很重要，所以我能理解，但我认为我们还是应该主动反击，因为回复垃圾正在毁掉这个平台，然后人们就会离开，而我不希望那样

过去十年我在这里交了很多朋友，也想继续交下去；如果我在这里的大部分互动都是在跟垃圾机器人打交道，我就没法再这样做了！

https://t.co/jDDqmG0c8h

posts.text:
🧔‍♂️ On Hoodmaps, for some reason the entire city of New York City became tagged green (rich) over time, I thought something was wrong and tried to fix it but was never able to

Hoodmaps works by letting anyone categorize a city's neighborhoods by coloring it based on if it's tourist (red), cool (yellow), rich (green), business (blue), university (dark blue) or crime (dark gray)

It would then take ALL the pixel drawings by everybody over the last decade and calculate the median for every pixel

But it all became "rich", why? So I asked Fable 5.2 today and it figured it out

Over time with more data you get general average tendencies of people that become a problem where big cities are mostly painted rich (green) because people see them as expensive, but that's not very useful information to navigate a city

So Fable 5.2 suggested to calculate each category color by calculating what's more common there than in the city as whole

And it works! And you can see very granular data now like the NYU university area with a spike seeping into Union Square but then being surrounded by tourists, or Hunters Point being a mix of tourists, crime and businesses
posts.text_zh:
🧔‍♂️ 在 Hoodmaps 上，不知为什么，整个 New York City 随着时间推移都被标成了绿色（rich，富人区），我以为出了问题，也试过修复，但一直没能修好。

Hoodmaps 的原理是让任何人给一座城市的街区分类上色：tourist（红色，游客区）、cool（黄色，酷街区）、rich（绿色，富人区）、business（蓝色，商务区）、university（深蓝色，大学区）或 crime（深灰色，犯罪区）。

然后它会把过去十年里所有人画过的像素全部拿来，计算每个像素的中位数。

可结果全变成了 “rich”，为什么？于是我今天问了 Fable 5.2，它找出了原因。

随着数据变多，会出现人们的总体平均倾向，这会变成一个问题：大城市大多被涂成 rich（绿色），因为人们觉得这些地方很贵，但这对在城市里找路并没有多大用处。

所以 Fable 5.2 建议：每个分类颜色，按「该处比整座城市整体更常见」来计算。

而且有效！现在能看到非常细的颗粒度，比如 NYU 大学区有一块突起渗进 Union Square，但又被游客区包围；或者 Hunters Point 是游客、犯罪和商务混杂的区域。

quoted.text:
I've now fully integrated my new site Hotelist into Hoodmaps

So now it lets you tap [ 🏨 Hotels ] and you see all available hotels in the area

You can hover over them or tap them and it'll show the same hover tooltip you see on Hotelist, and then when you tap again it opens the hotel

Nice to find a good area in a city and then book a place there

This was a recommendation by AI to try and monetize Hoodmaps, it gets almost 171,000 vistors per month but never made money in almost a decade, so I asked AI

It makes sense cause hotels are something aligned with when you're trying to find the best area in a city and it makes money!

It only shows when you click [ 🏨 Hotels ] though, so not annoying
quoted.text_zh:
我已经把新站点 Hotelist 完全接入了 Hoodmaps。

现在点击 [ 🏨 Hotels ]，就能看到该地区所有可订酒店。

把鼠标悬停或点一下，会看到和 Hotelist 上一样的悬停提示，再点一次就会打开这家酒店。

很适合先在城市里找到一个好区域，然后再在那里订住处。

这是 AI 给的建议，想给 Hoodmaps 找变现方式——它每月差不多有 171,000 名访问者，但近十年几乎从没赚过钱，所以我去问了 AI。

这很合理，因为你在一座城市里找最佳区域的时候，酒店正好对得上需求，而且能赚钱！

不过只有在你点击 [ 🏨 Hotels ] 时才会显示，所以并不打扰。
